notes: The Potrero View, Potrero Hill's community monthly, every issue in the Internet Archive collection sanfrancisconewspapers: 342 items, August 1970 to December 1977 and January 1986 to December 2009 (the collection holds nothing for 1978-1985). coverage.note: 6,292 OCR pages in 341 issues; 22,673 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets (with --alias DEHARO=DE HARO, and --untyped for De Haro, Rhode Island, Kansas, Wisconsin, Connecticut, Arkansas, Missouri, Mississippi, Vermont, Carolina, Texas, San Bruno, Pennsylvania, Mariposa, Tennessee, Minnesota, Indiana, Illinois). ocr_mentions.py kept 925 windows; 1,753 advertisement- or advertiser-dropped windows carrying a strong event word were added back: 2,678 windows read by hand by eight readers. 289 candidates; 163 set aside before entry - real-estate listing ads (build years and remodels of private houses), restorations and remodels with no date, undated former uses, repeats of one event across issues, announced openings and plans never confirmed, numbers the window does not print, businesses named for their proprietor, OCR-mangled names, and venues for one-off events. 126 findings written.
